name: Body and Heart
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Directly east of Auberdine lay many moonkin caves.  The one closest to Auberdine has a Moonkin Stone inside it.  Lunaclaw, the defender of the stone, will face you only when Cenarion Moondust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Moondust, adventurer... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
narrative.objectives:
Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw.  From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, adventurer. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.

There are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a Druid of the Claw!
narrative.endText: Face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests at level 10, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.objectiveText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade.

quests.name: Great Bear Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.

quests.name: Back to Darnassus
quests.objectiveText: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.

quests.objectiveText: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw.
